show.description: Days before his wedding, Akshat chooses a radical memory erasure procedure to forget Soumya after she abandons him for her supposedly terminally ill ex, Harsh, only for the truth to emerge too late, leaving Soumya desperate to reclaim a love Akshat no longer remembers.
